hero.title: CubicLauncher
hero.description: A free, open-source Minecraft launcher. Lightweight, configurable and designed to make the most of your hardware without pushing it too hard.

home.feature1Desc: Create multiple Minecraft instances with different versions, mods and settings, all organized in one place.
home.feature2Desc: The code is open on GitHub. Audit it, tweak it or contribute.
home.feature3Desc: Supports Premium, NoPremium and Ely.by accounts. Switch between profiles securely and without friction.
home.feature4Desc: It uses few resources and keeps a stable performance, even on lower-end hardware.
home.feature5Desc: Tune the launcher behavior and Minecraft settings to match your preferences.
home.feature6Desc: Install mods, modloaders, texture packs and check logs directly from the launcher.
home.feature7Desc: CubicLauncher is not a fork. It was built from scratch, with every component designed for the project.
home.mission: Our goal is for anyone to play Minecraft with a stable, fast launcher under their own control. CubicLauncher is free, open source and compatible with Premium, NoPremium and Ely.by accounts.
home.valueSubtitle: A launcher built to deliver real performance, freedom and accessibility. No forced premium accounts, no ads, and the user stays in control.
home.value1Desc: No hidden costs, subscriptions or restrictions. Download it, use it and adapt it to your needs.
home.value2Desc: Uses few resources and keeps a stable execution across different systems.
home.value3Desc: Available for Windows, Linux and macOS. The same experience on any of the three.
home.value4Desc: Personalize the launcher's appearance with community themes and tailor it to the way you play.
home.value5Desc: We didn't inherit code from other launchers. Every line was written in this repository.
home.quickStartSubtitle: Select your operating system, download the installer and open CubicLauncher.

about.title: About
about.paragraph1: CubicLauncher was born in Rust, built by a Spanish-speaking team. We designed it as a launcher with a clean, modern interface that never feels intrusive, without sacrificing performance or features.
about.paragraph2: We also want you to customize it with community-made themes and keep control over your experience.
about.paragraph3: Being open source under the GPL license, anyone can review how it works. That brings more trust and transparency.
about.paragraph4: We didn't start from a fork. CubicLauncher is developed from scratch, with custom crates tailored to what we need.
about.contributeDescription: You can report bugs, suggest ideas, create themes or submit code on GitHub. Every contribution helps.

install.title: Install
install.subtitle: Choose your operating system and download the latest version.
install.lookingForOther: Looking for another version or architecture?

platforms.windowsReq: Windows 10 64-bit or later. 4GB RAM minimum recommended.
platforms.windowsStep2: Run the file. If Windows SmartScreen shows a warning, click 'More info' and then 'Run anyway'.
platforms.windowsStep4: Launch CubicLauncher from the Start menu.
platforms.linuxDesc: Universal AppImage for most Linux distributions.
platforms.linuxStep2: Right-click the downloaded file, select 'Properties', go to the 'Permissions' tab, and check 'Allow executing file as program'. Alternatively, run chmod +x cubiclauncher.AppImage in the terminal.
platforms.macosDesc: Universal application for Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) and Intel processors.
platforms.macosStep2: Open the file and drag the CubicLauncher icon to the Applications folder.
platforms.macosStep3: The first time you open it, macOS may prevent it from running. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click 'Open Anyway'.
